set.tovw: Lead grade D (treasure thread): the killer took the money belt; money hidden on the farm is only the 1936 belief
set.t: D: the money belt was taken by the killer; hidden money on the farm is only rumor. Farmstead yard, outbuildings and the grain-stack ground near the house. Private land: ask permission.

tw-mn-bristol-olson-brothers-1936.st: In 1939 the state crime bureau told a grand jury the killer robbed Sever of a money belt believed to hold several thousand dollars; Knute still had $850 on him.
src: Austin Daily Herald, 4 Dec 1939, p. 1 (Newspapers.com image 1002849791, PC (a))
